name: slack-channel-context
description: Automatically loads Slack channel context files into session context for Slack channels and threads.
author: Brian McGowan

SLACK_CONTEXT_LOAD_ON_THREADS.description: Whether to load context in threaded messages (true/false). Set to false to disable context loading in threads.

SLACK_CONTEXT_LOAD_ON_THREAD_START.description: Whether to load context on thread/session start (true/false)

tools.name: load_channel_context
tools.description: Load Slack channel context into the current session.
